title: The lunch and keys on opposite sides
body: A lunchbox sits behind a chalk line across the floor. The keyring is on the other side, threaded through red cloth pulled tight enough to fray.
rival_reading: A program crew could leave keys outside a marked work area while moving supplies; the line and abandoned lunch do not show that an evacuation order failed.
gloss: A meal and its access keys have been left on opposite sides of a boundary.

title: A green line above the water mark
body: A green smear dried above the water line inside the bucket. A notebook served as its lid; the page that touched it is blank, with plant impressions where writing might have been.
rival_reading: A cleanup crew could use a bucket and notebook to inspect a warehouse spill; the residue could be ordinary growth rather than an agricultural program malfunction.
gloss: A bucket’s residue left a plant-shaped impression on the notebook used as its cover.
